name: hypes
description: Recommend how much help to offer in the current conversation without applying or storing it.

interface.shortDescription: Recommend how much help to offer
interface.longDescription: Hypes uses confirmed corrections and outcomes tied to an earlier delivered baseline to recommend how much help to offer next. The calculator returns a separate recommendation marked as not applied; it does not write a profile, database, or cross-conversation state.
defaultPrompt: Calculate a separate help recommendation for this task without applying it to the response.
Recalculate the recommendation using only confirmed corrections from this conversation.
Check whether the Hypes recommendation preserves the baseline plan and responsibility boundary.
